mentions.name: Lightweight ADB-based F-Droid app
mentions.description: A lightweight F-Droid-style Android app that uses ADB to download apps directly to the phone, sparing users the lengthy manual installation procedures that have become a pain as Android restricts third-party apps. The app is essentially complete and planned for release on GitHub, with in-app security checks for downloads still being implemented since it bypasses Android's own security mechanisms.
mentions.problem: Android is stopping third-party apps, and the existing procedures required to download and install apps are lengthy and painful.
mentions.audience: Android users who want to install apps without lengthy manual procedures
mentions.source_excerpt: After seeing that Android is stopping third party apps i decided to make a lightweight F droid app that uses adb to download stuff directly to the phone so you don't need to do all those lengthy procedures and stuff that are a pain.
